responsibility: Declares the main symbol-table subsystem for the GNU Modula-2 front end. This interface owns creation of every major symbol kind—modules, procedures, variables, constants, types, records, arrays, sets, pointers, imports, constructors, inline asm and more—together with scope entry/exit, current-module tracking, declaration/use metadata, import-statement bookkeeping, type navigation, quad attachments, builtin and packing flags, variable initialization state, and the numerous getters, setters, and iteration hooks that every parser pass, semantic analysis routine, and GCC-lowering stage uses to consume or update front-end symbol data.
same_name_distinction: This `.def` file is the exported contract for the gm2 symbol-table subsystem, listing the many constructors, scope operations, queries, and mutators available to other modules, while `SymbolTable.mod` holds the actual symbol record representations and state-management logic behind them.
